source_generation.prompt: A single bright red ball rolling slowly from left to right across a smooth white tabletop, fixed camera, soft daylight, simple clean background.

method.mask: RGB pixels where R > 150, G < 125, and B < 125
method.summary: Per-frame color-mask pixel count, centroid, and bounding box; frame order is 000 through 016.
limitations: The color mask is a simple proxy, not a segmentation model or ground-truth object track.
Bounding-box and mask growth indicate apparent image-space size change; they do not establish metric 3D scale drift.
A separate geometry/depth or object-tracking measurement is needed to confirm the suspected scale inconsistency.

interpretation: The requested rightward motion is present in the color-mask centroid, with a small downward drift. The object also grows substantially in image space over the sequence, making scale/shape consistency a stronger candidate failure than absent motion. This is a post-hoc measurement and is not part of the original run manifest.
